name: Crew Pressure
description: Your old set is reaching out. They want you to rep. But this life and that life don't always mix.

chapters.title: The Request
chapters.description: Big homie from back in the day hit you up. They're proud of your success. They want you to represent the set publicly.

choices.label: Rep the Set
choices.description: They held you down before you had anything. You owe them.

choices.label: Keep It Separate
choices.description: Love the homies but you can't mix these worlds.

choices.label: Buy Time
choices.description: Tell them you need to think about it.

chapters.title: Colors in the Ring
chapters.description: You showed up to your last battle repping the set. It made waves. Some leagues don't want that energy.

choices.label: Keep Repping
choices.description: This is who you are. If leagues don't want you, that's on them.

choices.label: Tone It Down
choices.description: You made your point. Now be strategic about it.

chapters.title: Word Gets Back
chapters.description: They heard you're acting different now that you're getting money. Some of them are taking it personal.

choices.label: Explain Yourself
choices.description: Pull up and talk to them face to face.

choices.label: Stay Away
choices.description: You made your choice. Live with it.

chapters.title: Time's Up
chapters.description: They're done waiting for an answer. Big homie showed up to your event. He's not happy.

choices.label: Stand on Your Decision
choices.description: You already told them no. That's your answer.

chapters.title: League Response
chapters.description: Two major leagues just told your manager they won't book you anymore. The gang ties are too hot.

choices.label: Accept It
choices.description: Some leagues don't want real ones. Their loss.

choices.label: Do Damage Control
choices.description: Put out a statement. Distance yourself professionally.

chapters.title: Disrespect
chapters.description: They're calling you a rat, a fake, a traitor. Some of them are showing up to your battles just to cause problems.

choices.label: Address It in Your Rounds
choices.description: Put it in your bars. Let them know how you feel about it.

choices.label: Increase Security
choices.description: Hire people. Don't go to events without protection.

choices.label: Try to Reconcile
choices.description: Set up a meeting. Try to fix this before it gets worse.

endings.title: Best of Both Worlds
endings.description: You found a balance. You show love when it matters but keep your career separate. The homies respect it.

endings.title: Mutual Respect
endings.description: They understood when you explained it. You're still family, just on different paths now.

endings.title: League Blacklist
endings.description: Major leagues won't book you. You're making less money but the streets love you more than ever.

endings.title: Corporate Move
endings.description: You kept your booking money but some people see you different now. The streets talk.

endings.title: Said What You Said
endings.description: You addressed it publicly. Some respect it, some don't. At least you weren't quiet about it.

endings.title: Looking Over Your Shoulder
endings.description: You're safe but you're spending money on security. You can't enjoy events the same way anymore.

endings.title: Uneasy Peace
endings.description: You talked it out. They're not actively coming at you, but things will never be the same.
